run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute minimum cost to cut a board into squares given horizontal and vertical cut costs
test_f_gold: test f_gold with lists of horizontal and vertical cut costs and their counts
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating input lists X and Y via in-place sort
review_f_gold: review f_gold greedy algorithm that processes largest cuts first to minimize total board cutting cost
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which calculates minimum cost to cut a board into unit squares using horizontal and vertical cuts
